description: v5 color-science overhaul E2E corpus. sweep_ghs/sweep_mtf/sweep_arcsinh are the bit-identical regression floor (stretch math is unchanged by the color-science overhaul, run against the same mono-L corpus so color/composer code never enters the path). mono_lrgb_ngc7635_v5 is the only live color-science case on this machine; bayer_rgb_ngc7635_v5, bayer_nb_hao3_m27, bayer_nb_s2o3_target and lrgbsho_target are scaffolded but skip:true until their corpora are captured.

cases.name: bayer_rgb_ngc7635_v5
cases.skip_reason: no NGC7635 OSC/Bayer-RGB corpus on this machine — /mnt/qnap/astro_data/NGC7635/OSC/Lights does not exist. The NGC7635 corpus captured here is filter-wheel LRGB only (L/R/G/B/Ha dirs), not one-shot-color.

cases.name: bayer_nb_hao3_m27
cases.visual_bar: no green cast; calibrated red+cyan distribution
cases.skip_reason: no HaO3 dual-NB OSC corpus — /mnt/qnap/astro_data/M27/HaO3/Lights does not exist. The M27 corpus captured here is LRGB-mono (single Light/ dir mixing L/R/G/B filter-wheel frames), not dual-narrowband OSC — this is the motivating case for a future capture session, not for this run.

cases.name: bayer_nb_s2o3_target
cases.skip_reason: no S2O3 dual-NB corpus — /mnt/qnap/astro_data/SH2-101/S2O3/Lights does not exist; SH2-101 has not been captured on this machine at all.

cases.name: lrgbsho_target
cases.skip_reason: no mixed LRGB+HaO3 corpus — /mnt/qnap/astro_data/M27/LRGBSHO/Lights does not exist. M27 corpus captured here is LRGB-mono only (no narrowband channels), so there is nothing to combine with L/R/G/B.
